name: Cindy Larae Hallman
office: Saugus Union School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Cindy Larae Hallman is a retired educator. She says she worked in education for 40 years, including 25 years as a teacher in the Saugus Union School District. She says she later worked as an administrator and an education professor at The Master's University.

sentences.text: Cindy Larae Hallman is a retired educator.
She says she worked in education for 40 years, including 25 years as a teacher in the Saugus Union School District.
She says she later worked as an administrator and an education professor at The Master's University.

items.text: In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, she said the school district's top problems are student misbehavior and too many required programs for teachers. She proposes giving teachers more professional autonomy and reducing the number of programs they must implement each day. Her campaign also advocates for limiting artificial intelligence use and screen time for elementary students.
